challengeTypes: identify: When should we wash our hands with soap? (Before eating and after toilet vs Only at night vs Never)
identify: How many times should we brush our teeth? (Twice daily - morning and night vs Once a week vs Never)
identify: Why should we cut our nails? (To stop dirt and germs hiding under nails vs To look pretty vs To scratch)
sort: Drag hygiene habits to the right time (Morning: brush teeth, bathe | Before eating: wash hands | After toilet: wash hands | Daily: wear clean clothes)
identify: What happens if we do NOT bathe daily? (Sweat and dirt cause rashes and boils vs Nothing happens vs We get taller)
identify: Why should we wear clean clothes? (Prevents rashes and boils vs To show off vs It does not matter)
sort: Drag items to clean vs dirty habits (Clean: wash hands, brush teeth, bathe, clean nails | Dirty: dirty nails, unwashed hands, dirty clothes, not brushing)
sort: Drag hygiene tools to what they do (Clean teeth: toothbrush | Wash hands: soap | Dry body: towel | Cut nails: nail clipper | Neat hair: comb)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. Teach: (1) Wash hands with soap before eating and after toilet. (2) Brush teeth twice daily - morning and night. (3) Bathe daily with soap. (4) Wear clean clothes. (5) Keep nails short and clean. (6) Comb hair. Misconceptions: "I do not need to wash hands if they look clean" (germs are invisible, wash with soap anyway), "brushing once is enough" (brush twice - morning and night), "long nails are fine" (dirt and germs hide under long nails). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function CleanlinessGame), NOT export default. Export interface CleanlinessGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
